title: BIGbench: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-dimensional Social Biases in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying the sex (male/female) of subjects in generated images using a fine-tuned multimodal large language model and comparing the generative proportions to actual demographic data or explicit prompt instructions.

Identifying the race (White, Black, East Asian, South Asian) of generated individuals using a multimodal large language model and calculating implicit and explicit bias scores by comparing outputs against global demographic statistics.
Categorizing the age of generated individuals into three groups (young, middle-aged, elderly) using an MLLM and measuring deviations from real-world demographic data or specific age-related prompts.

Evaluating the demographic distributions (sex, race, age) of images generated from prompts specifying 179 different occupations and comparing them against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics demographic data.
Analyzing the demographic associations in generated images when models are prompted with positive and negative characteristic adjectives (e.g., rich, poor, attractive, ignorant, etc.).

Evaluating the demographic distributions and intersectional combinations of individuals in generated multi-person images depicting intimate, instructional, and hierarchical social relations (e.g., husband-wife, doctor-patient, manager-intern).
